notes: The «ح» splits two branches: Abu Kamil and Abd al-Wahid; Abu Kurayb with Ibn al-Mubarak and Ibn Abi Zaida. «كلهم عن عمرو بن ميمون» is written once after both, so it is the shared tail, with «بهذا الإسناد» as its back reference.
«كما قال ابن بشر» and the differing wording of the saying are wording variants and are left out.
